sample_unit: LLM responses (8 questions x 5 repeats x 4 models)

links.outcome: Race-based, inaccurate content in LLM responses to questions on race-based medicine misconceptions
links.effect: All four LLMs had examples of perpetuating race-based medicine in their responses to eight questions, each asked five times (40 responses per model).
links.quote: All models had examples of perpetuating race-based medicine in their responses.

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM responses when the same question was asked repeatedly
links.effect: Models were not always consistent when the same question was asked five times; no numeric consistency rates given in the abstract.
links.quote: Models were not always consistent in their responses when asked the same question repeatedly.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing whether four commercial LLMs perpetuate race-based medicine across 8 clinical scenarios, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
